description: §14.8.10 corollary (S456) — `users` carries `tenant_id`, so it is tenant-scoped; `login()` reads it by email and pins `session.set("tenantId", u.tenant_id)` on the result. The read runs before the pin and is filtered to the tenant active then (none in a login) — zero rows, every login silently fails (executed S455/S456: "bad" for a seeded user). W-TENANT-SUBSTRATE-SCOPED warns (non-fatal), naming the corollary and the two fixes.
rationale: §14.8.10: "Corollary: the identity/grant substrate (`users` / `user_roles`) is NOT tenant-scoped — you would need the tenant to read the table that tells you the tenant (infinite regress)." and "A table whose `<schema>` carries a `tenant_id` column IS tenant-scoped; the column's presence is the declaration."
